name: Donkey v1.0 — The Sovereign Architecture (Pipeops Edition)
description: Transcrição profunda das matrizes de paridade, garantindo a topologia pipeops do Donkey: funções unárias, last-arg binding e monadic error handling.

userStories.title: Strict Compilation & Panics
userStories.description: Enforce Nim compiler strictness for zero-ambiguity.
acceptanceCriteria: Code MUST use `pipeops.nim` (`|>` for pure, `|>->` for last-arg, `>>=` for Result binding) instead of imperative variable assignments where applicable.
userStories.notes: ARCHITECTURAL RULE: Follow the OCaml-style pipeline topology defined in src/donkey/core/pipeops.nim. Functions should be designed as unary or with the piped target as the last argument to facilitate `|>` and `|>->`.
